newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha slips lower in very slow market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha slips lower in very slow market.

text.p: NWE naphtha slipped $1 or so on Friday in very thin trade. Dealers said the drop was in reaction to crude's recent drops.

"Naphtha held steady yesterday when crude fell, but it should be off today," said one who conceeded that the market was almost entirely notional because liquidity was thin because of industry functions and public holidays in the U.S.
Cif NWE naphtha was put at $174/175 with swaps about 50 cents firmer for July. August swaps showed a steeper contango at $177.50.
